author: Seung Wook
problem: 2N people stand in a row, wearing clothes of colors 1 to N, with each color worn by exactly two people. Print how many colors have exactly one person standing between the two people wearing that color.
bug_description: The loop runs over range(n-2) instead of range(2*n-2), so only the first N-2 positions of the 2N-person row are checked.

comments.accurate: Counts the colors whose two wearers have exactly one person between them
comments.wrong_behavior: Counts matches two places apart, scanning N-2 positions of the row
comments.wrong_location: Loop range verified; check the input reading, where readline and rstrip might leave stray characters
